item.title: Benjamin Renard
item.description:
Researcher in Statistical Hydrology


Modified from Ehud Tal

My research revolves around the development of probabilistic models to quantify uncertainties in hydrologic data and models, and to describe the space-time variability of hydrologic extremes such as floods and droughts.

The list of scientific papers I contributed to can be found on ORCID.

Development codes and operational software I am contributing to can be found on my GitHub page.

I try to discuss and illustrate my work in a ♫ musical blog ♫
